scenes.vo: I returned the library book on Monday. On Tuesday, it was back on my desk. With a new last chapter.
scenes.cap: Returned it Monday. Tuesday it was on my desk. New last chapter.

scenes.vo: The librarian checked. Returned, stamped, on the shelf. She said no one had borrowed it since.
scenes.cap: Library record: returned. Shelved. Not borrowed since.

scenes.vo: The new chapter was about a woman in a small flat, eating cold rice at midnight. Reading a library book.
scenes.cap: The new chapter: a woman, cold rice at midnight, reading a library book

scenes.vo: That was me. That was my evening. Every detail. Even the cracked mug.
scenes.cap: That was me. Every detail. Even the cracked mug.

scenes.vo: The last page was about tomorrow morning. It said, at seven ten, she will open the door for the man in the grey coat.
scenes.cap: Last page: "At 7:10 she will open the door for the man in the grey coat."

scenes.vo: It's seven nine now. Someone just knocked. Through the peephole, I can see a grey sleeve.
scenes.cap: 7:09. A knock. Through the peephole: a grey sleeve.

scenes.vo: The book doesn't say what happens next. Would you open the door? Part two, tomorrow.
scenes.cap: Would you open the door? Part 2 tomorrow.
